column3: NKJV has “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text adds “or not?”
NKJV has “a donkey or an ox,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “a son or an ox.”
NKJV lacks “all” before “those who sit at the table,” as does the Textus Receptus; the critical text includes it.
Close to the Greek; “righteous” is rendered “just.”
